attacks.name: Plasma Blasters
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Plasma Blasters| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Adamantium Knife
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Agent Zero
steps: |!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Anti-Healing Factor Corrosive
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 3 would remove |!damage| from itself, this character may use this superpower. The enemy character does not remove any |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Kinetic Energy Absorption
superPowers.body: When this character is dealt |!damage| by a |!physical| attack, after this attack is resolved, if it is not Dazed, it gains 1 |!power| and may Advance |!movement_small|.
